description: How the three-card tarot spread works: past, present, next and situation, action, outcome, with a method for reading the story across the cards.
lede: The three-card tarot spread is a flexible layout that can tell a story over time or frame a choice. Here are two ways to read it.

layout.alt: Three gold-edged tarot cards in a row, numbered 1, 2 and 3 and labelled Past, Present and Next, under the title A three-card tarot spread, past, present, next.
layout.caption: Read left to right: what shaped the situation, where it stands now and where it may head.

two-ways.alt: Two rows of three numbered tarot cards. The top row is labelled Past, Present and Next. The bottom row is labelled Situation, Action and Outcome.
two-ways.caption: The same three places can tell a story over time or frame a choice. Pick the frame that suits your question before you draw.
